text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm~ Since he's coming, I want him to fully experience Japanese culture. Sushi, kimono, ninja...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Grass-san knows tea, and Akebono-san and Chiyono O-san know sumo! As for what else—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer! *That's right!*

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm going to throw a special party for Pappy, who's stopping by Japan♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Full-powered omotenashi hospitality, and presenting him with the Gold *This Earth*—that is *my plan*!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *Yes!* It's the ultimate classic for moments like this♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *This Earth*—it is future possibilities packed with dreams and wrapped in love.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nothing could be more fitting for a challenger bravely advancing toward a hope-filled future...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pappy is about to take on the biggest business deal since he started as a precious metals merchant...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pushing ahead through a steep, difficult path—it's just like a salmon run risking one's entire life!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: As his daughter, and as someone chasing a big dream just like him, I want to send Pappy my cheer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...It was the same when you talked about dreams with me and gave me *This Earth*.
choice_data_list: Could it be... you felt the same way with me too?
Could it be... you felt the same way with me too?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*Yes!* Leaping out into the world to encounter new possibilities—
I wanted to pay my respects to such a courageous challenger♪
choice_data_list: ...Thanks to you, it turned into a wonderful observation tour.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I merely gave you a little push. You should praise yourself for seeing it through to the end!
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll be the ultimate cheer for your father too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...*Thanks.* That's what I believe!
Some time passed after that, and the day Seeking the Pearl's father arrived in Japan finally came.

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text: Oh, Pearl! To treat me to such heartfelt hospitality...!

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text: And even a present—hm? Is this... a golden Earth?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *Yes! This Earth!*

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pappy has traveled the world and experienced so many possibilities... That experience will surely guide you to success!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *Seeking the dream*... To Pappy chasing a golden dream, I wish you a brilliant future ahead.

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text: *Oh, my little Pearl!*

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text: Ah, you've grown up so much...! To think the day would come when you would be the one gifting me the Earth—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Pappy!
Connecting with the world alongside this Earth made me into a truly worldwide pearl...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And from here on, I'm going to become even bigger.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This Earth! Future possibilities are scattered all across the world, and our dreams are limitless!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Listen! Pappy's business deal went through!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Are you serious?! You did it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If you muster your courage and take that step forward, a whole new world opens up... Pappy proved that firsthand.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I should try challenging something new, too.
...Maybe I should try challenging something new, too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nice decision♪ Both I and this Earth will always be cheering you on!
Some time passed after that, and the day Seeking the Pearl's father was scheduled to visit Japan arrived, however—

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text: ...To think Pearl would catch a cold, of all times. I really wanted to see her in person if possible.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: She was terribly disappointed as well... She asked me to deliver this message and gift in her place.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My beloved Pappy... It's unfortunate we couldn't meet, but we are connected across the same world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This Earth... No matter where you are, I will always be praying for your happiness.

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text: ...That gives me so much strength.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes. Pearl-san always gives courage to everyone around her!
choice_data_list: Her cheers helped me out a lot, too.
Her cheers helped me out a lot, too.

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text: ...As her father, I must properly live up to that. I'll make sure this deal is a complete success and come see her again.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —And that's what your father said.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "—I see. I'll be waiting, Pappy... together with this Earth."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, that business deal is guaranteed to succeed...! After all, it comes with his beloved daughter's personal guarantee!!
It was a genuinely touching scene... Perhaps that's why a certain thought suddenly popped back into my head.
choice_data_list: In the end, what actually was 'this Earth'...?

text_block_list.text: The mystery remains a mystery— Will the day ever come when the truth is revealed?
